generate_rag_responses: run the main function to generate LLM responses for RAG questions from a JSONL dataset
generate_with_system_message: run main with add_system_message to include a system prompt in RAG generation
generate_batched_inference: run main to batch messages in groups of 1000 for offline LLM inference
generate_tensor_parallel: run main with tensor_parallel_size to distribute LLM inference across GPUs via Ray
generate_multiple_samples: run main with samples greater than 1 to generate multiple responses per question
